body:
Done.

**Changes:**
- Deleted `src/content/test/` directory (contained test.mdx artifact, no references)
- Added `projectsCollection` to `src/content.config.ts` with schema matching all 9 project .mdx files

**Schema note:** `link` and `github` both optional — `hitman.mdx` has `github` but no `link`, all others have `link` but no `github`. Dispatch suggested `link` required; made it `.optional()` to match actual content.

**Verification:**
- `npx astro build` → 40 pages, 5.46s, no "Auto-generating collections" warning
- Pre-existing `three` type error in `HeroScene.tsx` unrelated to this change
